name: 2_y010 - Diseases and vaccines driving concerns over time - line

assignments.name: chart_title
assignments.value: Diseases and vaccines driving concerns over time

parameters.query:
SELECT subtopic, DATE(published_at) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM (
  SELECT ym.id, ym.published_at,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ycl.classification_type = 'sub_topic' THEN ycl.result ELSE NULL END) AS subtopic
  FROM warehouse.youscan_content yc
  JOIN warehouse.youscan_mentions ym ON ym.id = yc.youscan_mention_id
  JOIN warehouse.youscan_topics yt ON yt.youscan_topic_id = ym.youscan_topic_id
  JOIN warehouse.youscan_translations ytr ON ytr.youscan_mention_id = ym.id
  JOIN warehouse.youscan_classifications ycl ON ycl.youscan_translation_id = ytr.id
  WHERE yt.client_id = {{ $json.client_id }}
    AND ytr.translation IS NOT NULL
    AND ym.published_at >= '{{ $json.start_date }}'
    AND ym.published_at <= '{{ $json.end_date }}'
  GROUP BY ym.id
) t
WHERE subtopic IS NOT NULL
  AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%not related%'
  AND (subtopic NOT LIKE '%prevention%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%general%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%diagnosis%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%spread%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%child abuse%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%pregnancy%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%side effects%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%fear%' AND subtopic NOT LIKE '%risk factor%')
GROUP BY subtopic, d
ORDER BY d ASC, subtopic ASC;
